request: Twenty additional catalog-wide passes after PR 1295, including coverage, false-positive boundaries, shared recognition and performance.
reviewScope: All 293 catalog rules are considered against each lens. Executable equivalence variants run only where language, fixture and owner contracts make the transformation applicable. No-op or inapplicable variants retain documented boundaries; reviewedPassCount does not claim every mutation ran on every rule.

passes.evidence: Enumerate every source-owned rule, executable positive/negative contract, parser, severity and documented limitation. No new rule or promotion.
Rename resolved imported bindings only; reject transformations crossing parameters, writes or shadowed scopes.
Split supported ordinary string literals only when AST equality proves the same source meaning. TOML is excluded even if Python ast.parse accepts its superficial shape.
Group supported source expressions with AST equality. A regex prefilter must not conceal an import-proven parenthesized callee or whitespace around attribute punctuation.
Read Identifier and string-literal imported names at one shared boundary while retaining original local bindings, module and scope checks.
Traverse erased wrappers around direct callbacks while preserving original function nodes, direct-call ownership, framework provenance and nested-function exclusions.
Unwrap supported initializers before recognizing constant strings and lifecycle callbacks; retain mutation and binding guards.
Unwrap proven property values for CORS booleans, mock factories and duration schemas. Do not infer truthiness or custom mock provenance.
Recognize runtime-identical wrapped callees at existing Promise/service boundaries. Tag variants apply only when an authored fixture has an eligible tag.
No-substitution keys preserve static property identity. Dynamic templates and type-sensitive owners retain explicit exclusions.
Safe nonnegative integer literals may use equivalent hexadecimal syntax. Textual assertion-identity policy retains its spelling contract.
Decode static object-pattern keys without weakening the noncomputed, binding or nullable-collection guards.
Tabs and newlines between keyword tokens preserve statement semantics; quoted content is untouched.
Quote equivalent lowercase identifier tokens and rename supported dollar-quote delimiters without changing bodies; retain case-sensitive and unsupported identities.
Insert inert block comments at token boundaries, excluding prose/comment-policy owners.

passes.focus: HCL grouped maps and scalar identity
passes.evidence: Group eligible assignment values and direct override maps/scalars. Terraform CLI rejects grouped type declarations and override targets; those variants are excluded. Direct numeric literals compare by Decimal value with a distinct kind from strings and booleans.

passes.focus: HCL strings and template escape order
passes.evidence: Decode static string keys/values through the shared literal boundary, applying lexical $${ and %%{ escapes before Unicode decoding. Reject dynamic markers, malformed escapes and surrogate scalars.
Reorder applicable JSON objects and escape ordinary values while retaining their decoded meaning. No path-only finding is introduced.
Preserve line endings and signatures; inert string/comment mutations exclude prose owners. Check parse failures, duplicate locations and exact expected counts.

passes.focus: Interactions, fixes, corpus, cost and integration
passes.evidence: Retain existing suppression, severity/exit, malformed-input, generated-code, precedence and fix-convergence suites. Compare pinned corpora in bounded fresh processes, measure paired cold/warm timings and memory, then make verify and committed exact-revision rule classification.

supplementalReproductions: Parenthesized/whitespace-separated import-proven Python regex callees bypassed the fast candidate prefilter.
Grouped Terraform override output maps and scalars, escaped string values/keys and equivalent numeric literals concealed a self-repeating assertion.
Two direct Zod object factory quoted imports retained an Identifier-only gate; supplemental pre-fix tests reproduced both misses.
An invalid surrogate string was treated as an injected literal; the shared decoder now abstains.
HCL literal-template escapes were decoded at the wrong lexical boundary.
baselineEvidence.fixtureCorrections: Python AST mutations apply only to .py, never TOML. Non-null wrappers require valid callback grouping and TypeScript files. Terraform type constraints and override targets cannot accept general expression grouping. Prose, raw-text identity and type-fact contracts retain their exclusions. A fixture test accidentally launched from the repository root failed under disk pressure; its correct package-directory rerun passed and the failed launch is not counted as rule evidence.

admission.routing: sarj-ai/code-standards, because findings depend on Python/TypeScript source and HCL configuration semantics.
admission.failureMode: Runtime-equivalent expressions and literal/import spellings hide diagnostics already required by existing rules.
admission.owners: Existing regex assignment, mock oracle, Promise, service, schema, collection and test/lifecycle rules and their shared parsers. No new control or rule.
admission.upstream: Changing an upstream preset cannot repair custom owner recognizers; reuse maintained AST/parser facts and original scopes instead.
admission.harm: Rules miss the same swallowed test failure, silent catch, fixed sleep, CORS option, service dependency or self-repeating assertion solely because of equivalent source spelling.
admission.validity: No rule freezes a filename, current value or repository topology. Dynamic expressions, custom receivers, shadowing, type differences and indirect callback ownership remain excluded.
admission.boundary: Fix each existing recognizer and consolidate imported-name/direct-argument recognition; HCL keys and strings reuse the shared decoder.
admission.beforeImplementation: The 45 transformed TypeScript fixtures and supplemental native cases were labeled before their corresponding fixes.
admission.fixPolicy: No new autofix. Existing exact-output and second-pass convergence checks remain in the shared harness.

terraformCliProof.init: passed with backend disabled and local module only
terraformCliProof.observations: Grouped output maps/scalars and escaped/numeric-equivalent values are valid; grouped type declarations and override targets are invalid.

corpusInspection.classification: Every diagnostic, message and multiplicity is unchanged. Previously calibrated findings are not newly adjudicated as true positives.
corpusInspection.limits: All 164 native owners and 113 TypeScript owners without mandatory type services are scanned. Five mandatory type-service owners and 11 text owners are covered by typed/authored probes and full suites. Private identity, paths, snippets and hashes are omitted.
corpusInspection.isolation: run_isolated_corpora verifies already-local pins, selects tracked existing files for Git sources, and starts fresh processes for every root and bounded batch; default 250-file cap.

performance.protocol: Three fresh baseline/candidate process pairs per family scan the same 100 public files. Focused existing-positive inputs run five times per process: first cold call, median of four warm calls. HCL stress tests 1k/10k/100k ordinary dollars in a quoted literal.
performance.interpretation: Shared helpers remove duplicated recognition and repeated wrapper branches. Measurements do not establish a general speedup; coverage cost and concurrent local load remain visible.
performance.cacheBounds: Existing SQL/HCL source-fact caches retain 32 entries, line indexing one; no additional cache or path-only cache introduced. Decimal comparison does not expand numeric exponents.
performance.memory: Native peak RSS uses bytes on macOS. TypeScript RSS is sampled at completion, not claimed as peak.
performance.limits: Corpus wall-time pairs overlapped other local validation. Use the smaller paired experiment and owning performance gates for regression assessment.

release.immutableTags: Affected package versions and exact sibling pins advance; no tag retargeting.

validation.selfLint: 0 errors; existing warnings retained; no execution issues

commands: cd packages/typescript && npm exec -- vitest run tests/erased-expression-coverage.test.ts tests/rules/no-sleep-in-test-body.test.ts tests/rules/prefer-await-in-async-return.test.ts
code-standards --root . maintain rules changes --before origin/main --after HEAD
promotionRecommendation: Ship existing owners at current severities; no promotion. Retain documented false negatives that require dynamic, cross-file or provider/type proof absent from the owning parser.
